data.title: 2.0 mm inside bend radius on 2.0 mm HR — cracking risk
data.description: The rev B corner uses a 2.0 mm inside radius on 2.0 mm IS2062 E250. At 1.0x thickness the outer fibre strain is beyond what this grade tolerates transverse to the rolling direction, which is what produced the field cracking. Rev C opens the radius to 3.0 mm (1.5x thickness). Confirm the brake vee changes from 12 mm to 16 mm.
